title: History workspace: a sticky PromptBox media chip beats the ACTIVE entry - ops run on the wrong image
description: PROVEN on real data (2026-07-29). In the History workspace the ACTIVE entry is only used as a FALLBACK: MpiGroupHistoryBlock._generationFromPromptPayload prepends it ONLY when the PromptBox holds no chip of that media type (`wantsCurrentType && !hasCurrentTypeMedia`, ~line 1226). PromptBox chips are PERSISTED per workspace in state.promptMedia[wsKey] and restored on every mount, so one image chip left over from an earlier op silently owns Input_Image for every later PromptBox-driven run, no matter which entry is selected. Evidence from project "Cubric prompt tests": the same staged asset 5b9ea765 (= kleinEdit_002.png, 912x1152, made 21:54) is recorded in generationSettings.mediaItems of upscale_002/003/004/005 (23:43-23:47) AND upscale_007 (23:58), even though crop_011 (1241x1552) was created at 23:54 and was the ACTIVE entry. 912x1152 * 1.5 = 1368x1728 = the exact size of upscale_007, which is why this first read as "the factor is applied twice" - the factor was always right, the INPUT was wrong. Negative control in the same lineage: removeBackground_001 (23:49) correctly used upscale_003, because tool-driven ops (_runImageTool / crop) build mediaItems straight from currentItem and never consult the chip rail. The chip is also INVISIBLE in History - the PromptBox panel is hidden behind the prompt rail tool. Fix direction: in history mode the ACTIVE entry must own the first/required media slot and chips fill only the optional slots (kleinEdit 1+2, krea2Edit 1+1, qwenEdit 1+2; upscale/detail/inpaint/i2i are 1-slot).
